desc: Attended-only T6040 PCIe link-training candidate on proven V1 baseline 04e8829c. Source afd13c037597c0659cf4d0e37b75f0e3c4ad78ef changes exactly the two fixed port-core reset values where paired ApplePCIEBaseT8132Port::_resetPortHardware differs from m1n1: type APCIE_T8132 writes port+0x13c=0 instead of 0x10 and port+0x130=0x03020000 instead of 0x03000000. Both are ADT-derived port apertures; both ports receive the same delta. Captured ADT apcie-config-tunables touches only +0x140, so neither delta is overwritten. Artifact /Users/damsleth/Code/linux-build-out/t6040-pcie-port-reset-afd13c03/m1n1.bin SHA256 4316500701e247dd07a07ec799464499cc769cce32ab58e806bb8e7981860c6d size 1097728; two clean byte-identical builds. No SPMI, SMC, PMU, NVRAM, charger, firmware or new address. This is still an invasive PCIe/PHY boot path: exact-artifact review by claude, CJ approval, attended run, one pcie_init per power cycle. PASS = port0 DLL_LINK_ACTIVE and BCM4388 endpoint enumeration; collect both port link states. STOP/recover on abort/hang; never run V2.
